enchantments.tooltip: Kinetic Intensity +24%: +24% Enhancement bonus to critical damage with Force and Physical spells.
Kinetic Lore +24: Passive: Your Force, Physical and Untyped spells gain a 24% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Force Absorption +17%: Passive: 17% Enhancement Bonus to Force Absorption. (Absorption reduces damage from an element by a percentage, after resistance have been taken into account.)

Nearly Complete: Spell Focus: This item isn't quite finished, but it's only a step away from completion. Bring it to the forges on the upper floor of Gravenhollow and combine it with melted materials to restore this item to its full potential.
